note: DynamoDB auto scaling takes a minimum and maximum capacity and a target utilization (AutoScaling), so capacity follows the known curve between floor and ceiling. On-demand has no floor or ceiling; fixed capacity wastes quiet-hour spend.

Convert the schema with AWS SCT, apply it, then use DMS to replicate ongoing changes (dms Welcome: convert, apply converted code, then migrate data). A stops before any data moves; D applies no schema, so views and triggers are missing; C is a file transfer service (DataSync).
